raw.rationale: AZD5363 is a potent pan-AKT inhibitor whose single-agent activity in PRISM is largely limited to tumour lines with PI3K/AKT-pathway activation, especially PIK3CA-mutant breast and some gynecologic/gastric lines, while most lineages show no selective killing at 2.5 µM. Published PRISM/screening data indicate the strongest selective signals in breast, with weaker or sporadic effects in uterus, ovary, and gastric, and essentially no selective lineage-level effect elsewhere.
